record.question: Sundowning ____
options: occurs usually as a function of mania
record.explanation: Sundowning (sundown syndrome) is a well-established neuropsychiatric phenomenon characterized by worsening confusion, agitation, and behavioral disturbances in the late afternoon/evening, most commonly in dementia patients. None of the provided options correctly describe sundowning: it is not caused by overmedication, not associated with akathisia (a drug-induced motor restlessness), not associated with stupor (reduced consciousness), and not a function of mania.
